title: verification-arbiter verdict
description: Strict JSON contract emitted on stdout by the verification-arbiter subprocess (tester-split design §5.1, §5.3). Bob captures stdout, validates against this schema, then validates the 8-field tuple match against the open verification request before applying any ledger transition. Phase 1 ships only this schema; the arbiter binary is Phase 2.

verdict.description: Top-level verification outcome. AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE forces escalation; bob must NEVER auto-approve (mirrors audit_spawn.py policy).

request_id.description: Echo of the open verification request's request_id (32-hex SHA-256 prefix derived deterministically from the input tuple).

attempt_id.description: Echo of the bob-supplied attempt_id; distinguishes retries against the same component.

prior_state_version.description: Echo of the ledger state version at request open time. If the ledger moves between open and consume, the request is superseded.

bundle_hash.description: Echo of the SHA-256 hex of the canonicalized evidence bundle the arbiter reviewed.

plan_hash.description: Echo of the SHA-256 hex of the canonicalized test plan the arbiter scored coverage against.

inventory_hash.description: Echo of the SHA-256 hex of the env-adoption inventory.json at the time of verification (so tier-skip declarations are reproducible).

runner_version.description: Echo of the trusted_runner version string that produced the bundle.

rubric_version.description: Echo of the arbiter's evaluation rubric version (design §9 open question 6 — file lives at _meta/verification_rubric.yaml in Phase 2+).

uncovered.description: Requirement IDs (REQ-NNN) with no test in the bundle.

skipped_with_reason.description: First-class skip declarations (design §1, goal 5). A skip with reason is NOT a coverage gap.

concerns.description: Verification-arbiter concerns. blocker concerns force REJECTED.

bundle_recomputed_hash.description: SHA-256 of the bundle bytes the arbiter actually read from disk. If this differs from bundle_hash, the arbiter saw a different file than bob asked it to verify.

matches_input.description: Convenience: bundle_recomputed_hash == bundle_hash. Bob still re-checks; this field exists so a downstream consumer can fail fast on mismatch.

evidence_map.description: S048 / #116 R-B2/R-I3 — the citation map: for each covered success-criterion / REQ-ID, the verbatim passing-test nodeid(s) the arbiter cites as satisfying it. Bob's deterministic arm (claims.py R6 via deterministic_arm.corroborate_citations) verifies every cited nodeid EXISTS in the bundle's results[].tests[] AND has outcome=='passed', and REJECTS the INTEGRATED->VERIFIED transition if any cited nodeid is absent or non-passing (an invented/misattributed-evidence tell — a correlated-hallucination signal). REQUIRED key as of the rubric cutover (>=1.2.0): adding it to the required set is the load-bearing fix so the arbiter's hand-rolled validate_verdict accepts its OWN output. Empty {} is allowed (degraded/jest bundle with no per-test records, or a component covered only by skips-with-reason). Honest residual: catches invented evidence, NOT irrelevant-but-real citations.

additionalProperties.description: Verbatim passing-test nodeids (e.g. 'tests/test_x.py::test_a') cited as covering this REQ-ID.
